propositions: The store accepts event bodies containing live credentials without screening, allowing secrets to be written to the append-only store and auto-pushed to the shared tickets branch

A single unscreened comment containing a zsh environment dump with seven live credentials triggered GitHub push protection, blocking all concurrent agent store writes (153 queued commits) and presenting as transient contention rather than a security incident
The write seam is not limited to append_event; the reconciler's inbound_translate bypasses it by calling finalize_event's halves directly, leaving Jira-sourced untrusted external input unscreened

A deterministic pure secret screen implemented at _seam.finalize_event (the single function all writers route through) refuses writes matching high-confidence credential patterns, records the matched family and field location without echoing the secret, and provides an auditable CLI-only force override

Detection uses fixed-width windows and line-anchoring tuned by measurement against the live store to avoid defeating the entropy floor with padding and to distinguish live credentials from prose descriptions (5-match sweep: zero real secrets, five descriptions)

The refusal path must not echo secrets into stderr, logs, or disk; the override must be CLI-only, not exposed over MCP, and must record the bypassed families and override reason on the event for auditability
